code_audit_findings.description: Shaker.shake() previously bound tweens to the Shaker autoload without checking is_instance_valid(thing) on completion. Fixed by binding shake tween to thing.create_tween() with validity guards.

Shaker.shake_loop() created an infinite set_loops() tween on the global Shaker autoload instead of thing.create_tween(), causing freed lambda errors on cleanup. Fixed by binding shake_loop to thing.create_tween().set_loops().

EndTurnButton started enabled during the initial 1.0s opening hand draw animation, allowing concurrent turns. Fixed by disabling EndTurnButton until player_hand_drawn and during nuclear cutscene resolution.
Nuclear whiteout and fade tweens were bound to Player instead of Arena. Fixed by binding cutscene tweens to Arena.
